message.content:
**Kite**

In the hush of dawn, a ribbon of wind  
Sings a song of freedom, a silent hymn.  
A thread of hope, a feathered dream—  
A kite takes flight, a silver gleam.

It dances on the breath of clouds,  
A whispering flag in the sky’s vast shroud.  
Its tail a comet, trailing light,  
A fleeting comet in the morning bright.

The child’s laughter, a joyous shout,  
Guides the kite through the air, no doubt.  
Each tug a promise, each lift a vow,  
To chase horizons, to never bow.

The kite, a mirror of the soul’s desire,  
Soars higher than the tallest pyre.  
It knows no bounds, no earthly chain,  
Only the wind’s sweet, endless reign.

When twilight paints the world in gold,  
The kite’s story, brave and bold,  
Returns to earth, a gentle sigh,  
Until the next sunrise, it will fly.
